subject: Operationalizing no-train & prompt/response custody — SFTP vs API export question
messages:
From: Kayla Mendes <kayla@healthprime.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>; contracts@healthprime.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: No-train, ownership and export flow questions
Attachments: healthprime_dpa_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the call this morning. Before we proceed to legal review I wanted to clarify operational expectations around the no-training (no model improvement) commitment in the DPA and how Redwood will demonstrate compliance. Specific items we need to confirm before we redline: 

1) Proof of non-consumption: what evidence will you provide that data submitted under our tenant won't be used to train models? (examples: config toggle + attestation, separate non-adaptive runtime, ephemeral KV).
2) Prompt/response custody: we need to document whether prompt inputs and generated responses are considered exported customer data vs transient telemetry; customer requires the right to export session transcripts retained for troubleshooting.
3) Export paths: we prefer an SFTP export lane for nightly evidence bundles (encrypted at-rest) over API pulls — do you support SFTP export for evidence packs? If not, we'll need a clear API contract and polling cadence.

Attached is our initial DPA draft (healthprime_dpa_v1.pdf) with the suggested no-train language. Can you reply with an operational checklist and who on your team will provide the attestation and subprocessor evidence?

Best,
Kayla
Sr. PM, Integrations
HealthPrime

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Kayla Mendes <kayla@healthprime.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>; David Kim <david@redwood.ai>; Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: No-train, ownership and export flow questions

Kayla — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below, and I'm looping in Marissa (ops) and David / Kim (privacy/legal) to validate the attestation format and subprocessor list.

High level answers:
- Proof of non-consumption: Redwood supports a tenant-isolated, non-adaptive serving mode for contractually-protected tenants. Operational proof we can provide: (a) configuration snapshot showing non-learning toggle enabled, (b) runbook excerpt showing separate serving pools, (c) signed attestation from our Privacy Ops team that the tenant traffic was processed on non-adaptive runtime for the period.
- Prompt/response custody: by default we treat interaction logs as customer data. We can agree on retention windows; HealthPrime can request full nightly export of transcripts. We can also redact PII on export if you prefer.
- Export paths: We support both an encrypted SFTP drop for nightly evidence packs and a secure API export (mutual TLS). SFTP is possible and often easier for procurement.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to provide an "no-learn operational checklist" and example attestation PDF.
- David/Kim to confirm subprocessor attestation template and whether a SOC2 snapshot suffices vs per-subprocessor signed statements.
- I'll flag the SFTP lane with infra; give me a target cadence (nightly / daily / weekly) and retention TTL you want for the evidence pack.

On attachments: I'll attach the ops checklist and a template attestation in the follow-up.

— Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Kayla Mendes <kayla@healthprime.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 13:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: No-train, ownership and export flow questions
Attachments: no-learn-ops-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Kayla — adding the operational detail you asked for. See attached checklist (no-learn-ops-checklist.pdf) — excerpt and highlights below: 

- Tenant configuration: snapshot of tenant flags (no_learn=true) including timestamped audit log.
- Serving topology: identifier for non-adaptive GPU pool used (pool-id + region) with immutable deployment hashes.
- KV cache handling: confirmation that cache persistence is disabled for model update pipelines for this tenant's sessions.
- Evidence bundle contents (nightly): 
  * config_snapshot.json (timestamped)
  * runtime_logs.tar.gz (last 24h, redacted)
  * attestation.pdf (signed by Privacy Ops)
  * subprocessor_inventory.csv (current)

SFTP options we support: nightly drop at 02:00 UTC (configurable). Files are AES-256 encrypted and we can provision a one-time SFTP key or a persistent account depending on your preference. We can also support an API endpoint for on-demand exports (mutual TLS).

Questions for HealthPrime so we can lock cadence: 
- Which export format do you prefer (SFTP tar.gz vs API JSON objects)?
- Retention requirement for exported evidence? (default we keep per-tenant bundles for 90 days in the export archive unless otherwise requested)

If everyone is happy I can produce the first sample evidence bundle for a 7-day window for review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal, Customer Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Kayla Mendes <kayla@healthprime.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: No-train, ownership and export flow questions

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. HealthPrime prefers: 
- SFTP nightly drop (02:00 UTC) as a tar.gz encrypted bundle.
- Retention: we want evidence available for 180 days. After that, HealthPrime will be responsible for archival unless otherwise agreed.
- Subprocessor attestation: can you provide a CSV and a signed attestation that lists the active subprocessors and their regions? Our procurement team requires per-subprocessor location (country) and whether any subprocessors handle training pipelines.

One operational ask: can you include a field in the config_snapshot indicating "exported_by: redwood-ops" and a signature hash so we can validate chain-of-custody?

If you can produce a sample 7-day evidence bundle by EOD Friday we will run it through our internal auditor. Also please send the DocuSign link for our DPA so procurement can start the redline flow.

Appreciate the quick turn,
Kayla
Sr. PM, Integrations
HealthPrime

>
